RemoteLASTv works with LG webOS TVs, Samsung smart TVs, and Android TV / Google TV devices. Your phone and TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
Can I connect over mobile data or a different Wi-Fi network?

No. The app communicates with your TV over your local network, so both devices must be connected to the same network. Guest networks and some public or office Wi-Fi networks may block communication between devices, preventing your TV from appearing. Also, turn off any VPN on your phone.
Why does my LG TV ask me to pair again?
If you clear the app\'s data or reinstall it, your TV treats RemoteLASTv as a new device. Accept the pairing prompt on your TV again. The connection should then be remembered.
My Samsung TV shows an Allow / Deny popup

The first time you connect, your TV asks whether to allow the device. Select Allow using your TV\'s remote. If you accidentally selected Deny, open your TV\'s connection or external device manager settings, remove RemoteLASTv from the blocked list, and try connecting again.
My Android TV asks for a PIN

Enter the 6-character code displayed on your TV. You normally only need to complete pairing once, and the app can reconnect automatically afterward. If the code is rejected, check that you entered it correctly and try again. A new code may appear each time pairing starts.

Yes. When you open the app, it attempts to reconnect to the TV you used last. It also attempts to reconnect when you return to the app from the background. If you disconnect manually, you must select a TV again before reconnecting. You can turn off auto-reconnect in Settings.
Check that your TV is not going to sleep and that your Wi-Fi signal is stable. Restarting your router or TV may help. If the problem continues, scan for TVs again and reconnect.
Make sure the status at the top of the remote says Connected. If it does not, reconnect from the TV list. Some buttons, such as volume or power, may not be supported by every TV model.
Why can\'t I turn my TV on with the app?

Turning a TV off works on many supported TVs, but turning it on over the network depends on the TV model and its settings. Some TVs disconnect from the network in standby. Check your TV\'s settings for an option such as "Turn on via Wi-Fi" or "Wake on network".
How do I use Touchpad mode?
Swipe with one finger to move the pointer, then tap to select. Use a two-finger swipe to navigate or scroll where supported. You can switch back to D-pad mode at any time in Settings.
Why won\'t some app shortcuts open?

Samsung and Android TV devices may not allow apps to retrieve the full list of installed apps, so RemoteLASTv launches shortcuts using known app IDs. If an app is not installed or uses a different app ID, its shortcut may not work. LG TVs can report installed apps, so app shortcuts may be more reliable on those devices.
Voice input isn\'t working. How do I allow microphone access?

RemoteLASTv needs microphone permission for voice input. If you denied permission, open your phone\'s Settings > Apps > RemoteLASTv > Permissions, select Microphone, and choose Allow. If Android no longer shows the permission prompt, enable microphone access from system settings. Other app features can still work without microphone permission.
Where do I switch between D-pad and Touchpad?
Go to Settings > Remote layout and choose your preferred navigation mode.
How do I hide the media buttons?
Go to Settings > Remote layout and turn off the media buttons option. This hides the previous, play/pause, and next buttons together.
How do I remove or rename a saved TV?
Open the TV list and select your saved TV. From there, you can rename or remove it. Removing a TV also deletes its saved pairing information from this phone, so you may need to pair again later.
